notes: Boss GT-1000CORE is a compact desktop guitar multi-effects/amp-modeling processor (not rack-mountable, no rackUnits). Categorized as DSP (closest fit among allowed types) since "guitar effects processor" is not a listed type option. Port list compiled from the official Boss.info product/spec page, cross-checked against the Owner's Manual panel-description pages (via ManualsLib mirror, since static.roland.com blocked direct fetch with HTTP 403) and Roland support articles for power-adaptor spec. INPUT L and R/MONO are both 1/4" TS (unbalanced) instrument jacks — R/MONO is the primary guitar input; L is used only for stereo external-source input. OUTPUT R/MONO is 1/4" TS; OUTPUT L/PHONES is 1/4" TRS (doubles as a headphone jack). SEND1/2 and RETURN1/2 are TRS 1/4" jacks that can alternately function as stereo SEND(L,R)/RETURN(L,R) or as SUB OUT/AUX IN — modeled per their default SEND/RETURN roles. MIDI IN/OUT use 3.5mm TRS mini-jacks (TRS-MIDI convention, not 5-pin DIN) — mapped to midi-din as the closest listed connector id since no TRS-MIDI id exists in the allowed list; a standard TRS/MIDI adaptor cable is required in practice. USB COMPUTER port is USB Micro-B for audio/MIDI to a computer (bidirectional) — no USB speed/grade stated in spec, so grade omitted. DC IN is an external 9V DC barrel-type power input (uses included PSA-series AC adaptor, ~670 mA draw); modeled as dc-barrel. No Ethernet, video, or other connector types are present on this device — it is a pure guitar-effects audio processor.

ports.name: INPUT R/MONO
ports.note: 1/4" TS guitar/instrument input; used alone for mono input

ports.name: INPUT L
ports.note: 1/4" TS; used together with R/MONO for stereo input from another effects unit

ports.name: OUTPUT R/MONO
ports.note: 1/4" TS output to amp/mixer; used alone for mono output

ports.name: OUTPUT L/PHONES
ports.note: 1/4" TRS; doubles as stereo headphone output

ports.name: SEND 1
ports.note: 1/4" TRS; send to external effects loop 1 (can alternately serve as stereo SEND L or SUB OUT)

ports.name: RETURN 1
ports.note: 1/4" TRS; return from external effects loop 1 (can alternately serve as stereo RETURN L or AUX IN)

ports.name: SEND 2
ports.note: 1/4" TRS; send to external effects loop 2 (can alternately serve as stereo SEND R or SUB OUT)

ports.name: RETURN 2
ports.note: 1/4" TRS; return from external effects loop 2 (can alternately serve as stereo RETURN R or AUX IN)

ports.name: CTL2,3/EXP1
ports.note: 1/4" TRS jack for an expression pedal or dual footswitch

ports.name: CTL4,5/EXP2
ports.note: 1/4" TRS jack for an expression pedal or dual footswitch; can also switch guitar-amp channels

ports.name: MIDI IN
ports.note: 3.5mm TRS mini-jack (TRS-MIDI), requires TRS/MIDI adaptor cable; closest available connector id to the actual 3.5mm mini-jack used

ports.name: MIDI OUT
ports.note: 3.5mm TRS mini-jack (TRS-MIDI), requires TRS/MIDI adaptor cable; closest available connector id to the actual 3.5mm mini-jack used

ports.name: USB COMPUTER
ports.note: USB Micro-B port for audio/MIDI interfacing with a computer

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: External 9V DC input from included PSA-series AC adaptor; also functions as the power switch
